title: Three tracks
intro: Each track is a full studio: faculty, graduate residents, and a year-long industry engagement. Work is scoped before students begin.

items.name: Spatial Intelligence
items.body: Engines and AI for physical space—scanning, Gaussian splatting, and USD pipelines that move a site from capture to a place people can inhabit.

items.name: Human-Robot Interaction
items.kicker: BUY THE BODY · OWN THE SOUL
items.body: Behavioral design and character for machines. Students train Booster K1 robots and work in animatronics—never building the body, always authoring the soul. The track anchors the Robotics B.Des. launching Fall 2026.

items.name: Future of Gaming
items.body: Agentic tools, a jam-to-storefront pipeline, and indie incubation. Home to the largest on-ground Global Game Jam site in the U.S.—last year over 300 registered. Students ship, incubate, and return work to the floor.
